obs: American Paper Institute, Inc. v. American Electric Power Service Corp.

"In the absence of a specific command in PURPA to employ a particular standard of review, the full-avoided-cost rule must be reviewed solely under the more lenient arbitrary-and-capricious standard prescribed by the Administrative Procedure Act for judicial review of informal rulemaking."
Alaska Department of Environmental Conservation v. Environmental Protection Agency
"Because the Act itself does not specify a standard for judicial review in this instance, we apply the familiar default standard of the Administrative Procedure Act"
